discovery_adaptation.implementation: New Rust catalog refresh, cache and dynamic routing integration, using upstream/provider wire formats; no hardcoded model IDs.
discovery_adaptation.behavior: Mandatory account-scoped official catalog admission for every deployment, including legacy discover=false. Exact model IDs/aliases and explicit reasoning values must be supported by fresh authenticated metadata; missing evidence fails closed. Dynamic capability parsing with configurable official response pointers, no local allowlists or value rewrites. Fresh snapshots only, in memory and bound to credential revision, proxy, endpoint and profile. Scheduling, retries and pinning use each selected account catalog. Model listing exposes capabilities separately per deployment.
discovery_adaptation.limitations: OpenAI API-key catalogs and Claude manual budgets may lack required capability metadata; explicit controls fail closed without it. Omitted reasoning parameters remain omitted. Catalogs do not prove runtime model execution or all parameter combinations. Pricing imports live in the independent management platform; fixtures are not live vendor validation.

storage_adaptation.implementation: New Rust integration; all router state is now memory-only.
storage_adaptation.behavior: Router holds revision-controlled configuration, OAuth credentials, usage and model catalogs in memory. An external management service is responsible for encrypted persistence, initializing an empty router, and acknowledging checkpoints through the router API; its implementation is not included. Catalogs are rediscovered after restart.
storage_adaptation.key_management: Protected stdin or encrypted Phala environment bootstrap; management database key belongs to the separate management process.

operations_adaptation.implementation: New Rust integration; not claimed as an upstream port.
operations_adaptation.behavior: Validated configuration generations, atomic in-memory updates, account health, bounded session affinity and shared limits. Checkpoints contain no request bodies or ordinary responses; explicit refusal text and public refusal metadata are retained for administrator audit; management persists then acknowledges them. The router has no money accounting, database or backup file.

official_passthrough_adaptation.implementation: New teellm Rust code; not copied from LiteLLM.
official_passthrough_adaptation.behavior: Only official OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI HTTPS hosts are permitted, with redirects disabled. Raw model and effort values are preserved.

wire_configuration_adaptation.implementation: New teellm Rust code; no added runtime dependencies or script engine.
wire_configuration_adaptation.validation: All nonempty body edit rules are rejected at configuration activation and runtime. Generation header/query edits are rejected; only discovery metadata is configurable. Native requests preserve Agent parameters.

administrator_restrictions.implementation: New Rust deny-only policy, independent of immutable authenticated official catalog evidence.
administrator_restrictions.behavior: Deny-only provider/model blocks and thinking/effort restrictions subtract from authenticated catalog evidence without modifying it. The router does not require callers to supply a token budget.

refusal_audit.implementation: New Rust integration; LockLLM network scanning removed. Legacy moderation configuration and records are read-only compatibility data.
refusal_audit.behavior: Observe explicit upstream signals before conversion, merge streaming parts and enqueue each refusal once with a global increasing ID and user identity. Admins page across all users and delete the archived prefix by ID. No automatic eviction; backlog pauses admission. Checkpoint usage ACK is independent, usage events retain only refusal_id, and deleted bodies have no per-user or usage-log copy. Queue, counter and deletion watermark survive checkpoint restore. No request-body storage or plain-text refusal classification.
refusal_audit.validation: Local JSON/SSE fixtures for retained providers; no live vendor policy-trigger tests.
